stories.title: Fflint Wrecsam MS wants Flintshire residents to vote on any council tax rise of five per cent or more
stories.summary: A Flintshire-based politician wants any council tax rise of five per cent or more in the county put to a local referendum, and Flintshire and Wrexham councils to share back-office services. stories.title: Flintshire roadworks from 1 September: closures and temporary lights across the county
stories.summary: The A541 at Rhydymwyn is to close overnight for two weeks from Wednesday 2 September, one of four new sets of roadworks starting across Flintshire this week. stories.title: Update:  M56 eastbound reopens after serious collision closed it for more than eight hours
stories.summary: Update: The M56 eastbound has reopened between junction 14 at Hapsford and junction 12 at Runcorn after what Cheshire Police described as a serious collision closed it for more than eight hours on bank holiday Monday. stories.title: At-risk residents aged 65 to 74 offered RSV vaccine for first time
stories.summary: Residents aged between 65 and 74 who are at higher risk of serious illness if they contract RSV are being invited for a one-off vaccine to boost their protection against the virus. stories.title: Volunteer coastguard rescue officers wanted for mud, cliff and water rescues
stories.summary: HM Coastguard is looking for volunteer rescue officers, in an appeal shared by Flint Coastguard Rescue Team. Coastguard rescue officers are called out to mud, cliff and water rescues, and to searches for missing people.
